nextAction: Ready for user review; restart existing wf-ui server to pick up backend/UI changes and re-test the live project

acceptance.text: Snapshot/control-plane graph reads are authoritative, fresh, and not overwritten by stale browser-local graph state.
wf-ui-control create/describe path is covered through Harness control APIs; subagents get read-only snapshot tokens instead of stale local fallback.
Stopping a live session removes it from live registry, persists saved state, updates graph state, and disables stop via snapshot control.
Saved/not-managed graph nodes can be deleted from the workflow graph while transcript/session history is preserved.
Browser/API verification covers Workflow and Agents consistency, delete affordance, icons, and live-resource unknown values.
Runtime identity uses Harness environment variables and node init files instead of injected terminal bootstrap prompts.
PTY resource usage distinguishes unknown values from zero and avoids runtime detection stalls in session listing.
Runtime brand icons and colors render across workflow, agents, settings, and task surfaces.
Workflow nodes expose usable top/right/bottom/left source and target handles that remain clickable after canvas zoom.
wf-bridge records bidirectional session input and opens a transcript panel from the edge label.
Edge closed-loop verification covers bidirectional bridge messages, all-select delete, stop, icons, settings picker, and screenshots.

decisions: Treat live/saved/stopped/deleted workflow nodes as one backend-owned state model instead of independent UI guesses
Managed Main Agent -> Subagent control must be tested through Harness wf-ui-control/session APIs, not built-in model subagents
Subagents receive a read-only graph token for fresh snapshot/describe access; only Main Agents receive full control tokens
Node bootstrap identity must come from Harness env/node init, not from a UI-sent first prompt
Bridge messages are durable JSONL records keyed by session pair and displayed through a shared wf-bridge panel
risks: Live PTY stop/delete can leave durable saved nodes and graph nodes disagreeing
A2A graph snapshot may be cached or not invalidated fast enough for agents to perceive edge updates
E2E control tests must avoid launching expensive real CLIs unless explicitly isolated
